agenda: MT2 v2: no global frame of any kind (Peter's directive + the 0b/0c evidence: discrete frames are jitter amplifiers as a class). Geometry enters through per-slice equivariant anchors -- many local, data-adaptive reference points -- and point-anchor relational invariants.

architecture_change.removed: the entire principal-axis frame (weighted PCA, skew/drive/handedness orientation)
architecture_change.added: each slice block computes equivariant anchors z_s (measure-weighted softmax means of centered positions, smooth by construction) and feeds each point relational invariants against every anchor: |r_i - z_s|, rhat_is.d, rhat_is.n_i -- pooled through the same softmax machinery; separation by multilateration against ~256 anchors
architecture_change.contracts: similarity equivariance EXACT with no degeneracy caveat (no eigenbasis) and full O(3) restored (chirality construction removed); drive degree 1 and measure-aware aggregation unchanged

arms.protocol: frozen; identical instrument incl. P1 rotation + P3 exact-HT density probes

deciding_gates.V2_1_infamily: <= 1.36x GT (0c's level): the relational geometry must not cost accuracy; > 1.50x refutes
deciding_gates.V2_4_density: THE gate: < 8x (vs 0b 11.5-12.7x, 0c 19.8-28.4x); prediction p ~ 0.6 -- anchors move smoothly with resampling where eigenbases cliff
